text:
Sofia M: Heads-up — BluePeak sent invoice BP-3072 for $6,720 but the PO field is blank in their PDF (looks like exported from billing tool). The PO should be PO-33100. Need help routing and whether we can accept vendor email as proof.

Leon H: Can you paste invoice number and vendor ref? I'll try a manual match.

Sofia M: Invoice BP-3072, vendor ref: REF-987X. Attachment: bp_3072_scan.pdf (scanned copy).

finance-bot: Automated note: incoming invoice BP-3072 flagged: "no_po_detected". Suggested actions: 1) manual match to PO-33100, 2) request vendor reissue with PO in text, or 3) accept vendor statement with approver attestation.

AP Queue: From AP: Manual match allowed if requester attaches vendor email explicitly stating invoice ties to PO-33100 AND approver for PO verifies. If tax withholding applied differently than PO, AP needs vendor clarification and signed waiver.

BluePeak-billing: Hi Sofia — sorry about the blank PO field. We can reissue a PDF with PO-33100 included. Note: our system auto-applies 10% local service tax for exports; the PO was issued pre-tax so amounts differ. Do you want the invoice reissued gross (with tax line) or as a net with a separate tax credit note?

Sofia M: Please reissue gross with a dedicated tax line and show the PO in text. We need the math to match the PO totals after tax. Also attach vendor tax registration (VAT ID).

Leon H: I'll do a manual link in ProcureLink once we have the vendor email confirming PO mapping and the VAT ID. If they reissue today we'll avoid a payment delay.

AP Queue: Note: if reissued gross, AP will require approver confirmation for the extra tax charge (PO approver must sign off on the delta). Please confirm approver for PO-33100.

Sofia M: Approver is @Leon H for PO-33100. Leon, can you confirm you'd approve the extra tax line once vendor provides VAT ID and shows calculations?

Leon H: I can approve the tax line if vendor provides VAT ID and a clear calculation. If they can't provide VAT ID, AP will treat the tax as withheld and we may need to request a credit memo.

BluePeak-billing: Understood. We'll reissue BP-3072-R1 (PDF) with PO-33100 in text, add VAT ID: BE-445566, and an extra line for 10% service tax with calculation. Uploading now. Link: https://files.bluepeak.example/invoices/BP-3072-R1.pdf

finance-bot: File received. OCR found PO-33100 and VAT ID. Suggested auto-match to PO-33100.

AP Queue: AP action: proceed to auto-match. Invoice status: awaiting-approval. Approver: Leon H. Note: record audit comment "vendor reissued BP-3072-R1 with tax". Payment hold removed once approver signs.

Leon H: Approving now. Leaving PO note: "Approved tax line after vendor VAT ID provided and calc verified."

Sofia M: Thanks all — closing thread. Will follow up if AP needs any more documentation.

finance-bot: Thread closed: BP-3072 resolved."
